title: MP Materials Heavy Rare-Earth Separation Loan
publisher: U.S. Department of War, Office of Strategic Capital
summary: The Office of Strategic Capital records an executed $150 million direct loan to add heavy rare-earth separation at MP Materials' existing Mountain Pass processing site.
key_findings: The action is described as the Office's first executed direct loan.
The recipient, process capability, facility, location, and amount are named.
The transaction is one component of a wider July 2025 agreement.
why_it_matters: The record advances critical-minerals strategy into named project finance while leaving construction and production measurable as later stages.
ftfn_relevance: Connects public finance to later equipment, commissioning, qualification, and output evidence.
evidence_limits: The release does not prove the separation capability has been built or commissioned.
It does not establish feedstock, qualified product, customers, volume, economics, or repayment performance.
